openingMessage: Every crew in the field comes home today. That's not a goal — that's the standard. Here's how we hold it.
openingWhy: A man goes down at a thief hatch and every good hand's first instinct is to run to him. That instinct — no air, no test — is how one man down becomes three. The standard exists so that nobody's best instinct becomes the worst decision of his life.
leadershipThought: Slow down at the dig. Authorization before excavation is not bureaucracy. It's the step that has protected every crew that didn't lose someone.

todaysChallenge: Three rules, one day. Do right when the readings say stop. Do your best on the job nobody sees. And coach the newest hand the way you wish someone had coached you.
todaysChallengeSubtext: “Do right. Do your best. Treat others as you want to be treated.” — Lou Holtz
